description: This file is a markdown document describing the 'CompositeInput' Hardware Abstraction Layer (HAL) interface for analog composite video inputs. It includes detailed overview, interface definitions, implementation requirements, operation sequences, capabilities, event handling, system context, resource management, and various technical considerations for platform integration.

classes.name: ICompositeInputManager
classes.description: Manager interface for discovering and accessing composite input ports.

classes.name: ICompositeInputPort
classes.description: Interface for controlling and querying a specific composite input port.

classes.name: IPortEventListener
classes.description: Callback interface for receiving events like connection and signal status changes.

classes.name: IPortTelemetryListener
classes.description: Callback for receiving telemetry data and metrics.

classes.name: PortCapabilities
classes.description: Capabilities of individual ports including supported properties and metrics.

classes.name: PortStatus
classes.description: Current status of a port including connection, signal, and video mode.

classes.name: SignalStatus
classes.description: Enum representing the signal detection and stability states.

classes.name: VideoResolution
classes.description: Details about the detected video resolution and standard.

classes.name: PortMetrics
classes.description: Telemetry metrics for signal lock time, drops, uptime, etc.

classes.name: PropertyKVPair
classes.description: Key-value pair used for bulk property retrieval or setting.

classes.name: PropertyMetadata
classes.description: Metadata describing properties including type and description.

methods.name: getPlatformCapabilities
methods.description: Returns the platform-wide capabilities including supported ports.

methods.name: getPortIds
methods.description: Returns the list of available port IDs.

methods.name: getPort
methods.description: Returns the interface for a specific port by ID.

methods.name: getCapabilities
methods.description: Returns the capabilities of a specific port.

methods.name: getPortInfo
methods.description: Returns descriptive info about the port such as name and description.

methods.name: getProperty
methods.description: Retrieves a specific property value by key.

methods.name: registerEventListener
methods.description: Registers a callback for port events like connection or signal change.

methods.name: setActive
methods.description: Activates or deactivates the port for video presentation.
